_about: THE LANDMARKS: real things in the desert you can see from far off and walk to. Not settlements (no screen, no parties, no jobs). Read by slices/bohemia_region.js (__SEVEN_MAGIC_MOUNTAINS__); a modder adds the next one here. x and y are region blocks on the east-is-x1 compass (the valley's middle block is 47.5, 47.5 at 36.135 N, 115.17 W; a block is 384 m of real ground, engine/BOHEMIA_REGION_LAND.json's own scale). VAMILY rule 410, ask line 459.

landmarks.name: SEVEN MAGIC MOUNTAINS
landmarks.xy_why: 35.839 N, 115.271 W on the region's own formula is block 23.9, 133.1; it is set at 22 (1.4 blocks off, inside the region gate's 2.5) because the real piece stands beside Las Vegas Boulevard a few hundred metres off the I-15, and the region draws the I-15 about 1.5 km west of where it runs, so 22 keeps it near the road the way it really is
landmarks.real: Ugo Rondinone's Seven Magic Mountains (2016): seven stacks of 33 locally quarried limestone boulders, three to six a stack, about 25 to 35 feet tall, painted in day-glo colours, on the desert beside Las Vegas Boulevard south of Sloan and north of Jean, near Jean Dry Lake; free, open sunrise to sunset; meant for two years and kept on view since
landmarks.licence: a real public artwork by a living artist: its name and its look go on the stage-4 licence list with the game's other real names before a sale (records/BOHEMIA_THE_FINISH_LINE_AND_THE_ROAD_11_2_26.md, stage 4)
landmarks.stacks_why: the real count: 33 boulders in seven stacks of three to six
landmarks.colours_why: the real piece's day-glo pink, orange, yellow, lime, green, blue, violet, red and a silver-white
landmarks.fade_why: the real paint is redone every few years because the sun takes it; after the dollar died nobody repaints it, so every colour is a third of the way to the playa's dust: chalky, and still the brightest thing for kilometres (analog horror: a colour from before, going)
landmarks.see_why: day-glo rock ten metres tall on a flat dry lake reads for kilometres: about 6 km (16 blocks of 384 m) as a coloured mark; once he has been that close it shows through the fog for the rest of the game
landmarks.look_why: on top of a ten-metre stack, eyes about 11.7 m up, the horizon on the flat is sqrt(2 x 6371 km x 0.0117 km) = 12.2 km, 31.8 blocks; 30 kept, the hills cut some of it. Arriving lifts the fog that far round it, once a game

feed.txt: seven stacks of painted rock off the 15 by Jean. nobody repaints them now. from the top you can see the whole dry lake, and anybody crossing it
